# Mobile app — Flutter (FairShare)

`Mobile app/` is the Flutter client, shipped under the app name **FairShare** (Android
label and `MaterialApp.title`; the launcher icon is the two-partner mark). The Flutter
project is at the repository root of this segment (`lib/`, `pubspec.yaml`). Clean
Architecture (data / domain / presentation) with Bloc, GoRouter and GetIt.

## Commands

```bash
flutter analyze
flutter test                                  # ~37 passing
flutter test test/unit | test/feature | test/integration
flutter run --dart-define=API_BASE_URL=http://10.0.2.2:8000/mobile
```

`10.0.2.2` is the Android emulator's alias for the host machine; use your LAN IP for a
physical device. The base URL already ends in `/mobile`, so endpoint paths start `/v1/…`.

## Where things live

| Area | Path |
|---|---|
| Theme (Warm Sage tokens, Plus Jakarta Sans) | `lib/core/theme/app_theme.dart` |
| Shared widgets | `lib/core/theme/warm_widgets.dart` (`WarmCard`, `PriorityChip`, `StatPill`, `SectionHeader`, `WarmEmptyState`, `WarmBanner`) |
| Tab shell + tab aliases | `lib/core/router/main_shell.dart` |
| Routes (GoRouter) | `lib/core/router/app_router.dart` |
| Session / onboarding state | `lib/core/session/auth_session.dart` |
| DI | `lib/core/di/injector.dart` |
| Notification planning, local notifications, push, TTS | `lib/core/notifications/` |
| Geofence maths, native manager, location seam | `lib/core/geo/` |
| Features | `lib/features/{auth,onboarding,requests,places,pantry,recurring,feedback}/` |
| Tests | `test/{unit,feature,integration}` — see `TESTING.md` |

Navigation shape: `onboarding`, `login`, `register`, `verify-phone`; full-screen
`requests/new`, `requests/:id`, `feedback`, `receipt/scan`; and a `ShellRoute` with tabs
**Today · Shopping · Places · Settings**. `pantry` keeps Shopping lit and `recurring`
keeps Today lit through `MainShell._tabAliases`; `/home` redirects to `/today`.

## Rules that matter here

- **Talk to `/mobile`, not `/api`.** The base URL in `lib/core/config/app_config.dart`
  targets the mobile surface; its tokens carry the `mobile` ability.
- **A feature is a vertical slice**: entity → model → datasource → repository → bloc →
  page, registered in `lib/core/di/injector.dart`. Follow `/flutter-feature-slice`.
- **Keep board-contract parity with the web dashboard.** If the API's board gains a
  bucket, the `RequestBoard` entity and the Today page change with it.
- **Keep the marketing promises honest.** The static site advertises geofencing, recurring
  staples, the shared ledger and phone escalation; those exist on mobile, and OCR is
  receipt scanning only (machine-printed English receipts — state that in the UI).
- **One codebase for both platforms.** A device token's `platform` is push-provider
  metadata (FCM vs APNs), not an app variant. Per-OS work is limited to manifest /
  `Info.plist` declarations.
- **`BlocProvider` subscribes to the bloc**, so a mocked bloc fails on a null `stream`.
  Use a real bloc and stub the repository method the event reaches.
- **`any()` needs a fallback** for non-nullables: `registerFallbackValue('')` for a
  `String`, `registerFallbackValue(<String, dynamic>{})` for a map.
- **Assert inert controls by their handler** (`expect(circle.onTap, isNull)`); tapping a
  disabled `InkResponse` throws because it has no gesture recognizer.
- **`MainShell` takes its `location` as a parameter**, so tab highlighting is testable
  without standing up a router.
- **Touch targets are 44x44 minimum** even when the visual element is smaller.

## Manual QA

Point at your API and run the app; seeded accounts are in `Backend/TESTING.md` (password
`password`). Phase 5 of `Docs/phase-5-device-test-plan.md` covers the geofence checks that
need real hardware.
